sam: Who wants sourdough vs banana bread for 4pm snack run? also, coffee filter situation is tragic.
anya: Sourdough please. banana bread reserved for emotional debugging sessions.

noah: On the ride now. If anyone wants a pastry preference, shout now or forever hold your crumbs.
ben: Hummus + sourdough for me. Also shoutout to whoever refilled the sugar yesterday, you're a hero.
sam: Whoever you are, sugar-refiller, bless. I will bring a Sharpie and write dates on milk.
ops-bot: Automated note: Kitchen cleanliness score this week: 8/10. Most common issue: unclaimed mugs.
anya: Mug census idea: leave a sticky with name for 24h, then donate to "orphan mug" shelf.
noah: Arrived. Leaving pastry on the counter with a note: "take one, be kind". Also filters in the pantry. Back in 20 to lock bike.
ben: Thank you! passing the pastries around now. :tada:
sam: Short poll: reheated fish thumbs down? :fish: :x:
anya: :x: :laughing:
ben: Definitely :x:. Ok I'm eating quietly now. Thanks all :)
